notes.9v.23: N. marks where the patient's name is spoken. The † stands in the manuscript, probably as a sign of the cross.

nodes.text: I command you, worm, you who lie in the flesh, whether there is one of you, whether there are
two, however many of you there are, in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, by Jesus
of Nazareth, who was born in Bethlehem, who in the river Jordan
was baptised, who was tortured in Jerusalem, who on the Mount
of Olives went up to heaven: that you no more of the flesh
eat, and no more drink of the blood of this man
[N.], or of this woman. In God's name, amen. † Whoever for a person
wishes to cure the worm with this remedy, let him beware not to cure any beast of burden
with it, because afterwards it will not help a person.
